LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
Notice under Section 66(2)

IT is hereby declared that the names of the members elected for each ward of the Local Authority indicated in Column II ofthe Schedule below of the Local Authority Specified in Column II situated in the administrative district specified in ColumnI and the names of members returned for the Local Authority shall be specified below. This is an addition to the namespublished in the Gazette Extraordinary 2061/42 of 09th March, 2018.
